decisions.reason: As a niche 2019 standalone men’s care line with no visible later web presence, it appears less central to the firm’s publicly sustained direction, so even with sunk costs escalation is weaker and management is more likely to discontinue it.

Because the cleansing foam was launched as an extension of the Sandorini series, the firm has a more visible and brand-linked commitment that under escalation of commitment makes management somewhat more likely to retain it and attribute weak results to temporary factors.
